Assemble paymentPayload = {x402Version: 1, scheme: '<exact|aggr_deferred|upto>', network: <accepts entry network>, payload: {signature, authorization}}; header 'X-PAYMENT: btoa(JSON.stringify(paymentPayload))'; replay.

units.title: --payload format and --selected-index default
units.text: --payload = base64 (or base64url) of {x402Version, resource, accepts} (the raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value); CLI decodes, signs, returns assembled header (v2). --selected-index = 0-based index into accepts[]; omitted -> CLI auto-selects exact > aggr_deferred > first. Signs from the currently selected wallet account.

units.title: upto requires extra.facilitatorAddress
units.text: 'upto scheme requires extra.facilitatorAddress' -> seller's 402 lacks facilitatorAddress in accepts[].extra; seller misconfig — don't retry; tell the user and stop.

units.title: Replay 402 again / network error on replay
units.text: Replay returns 402 again -> typically a stale signature: re-fetch a fresh 402 and re-sign; never reuse a stale signature. Network error on replay -> retry once, then prompt the user.

units.title: Facilitator bug-class errors: surface and stop
units.text: invalid_permit2_spender-class invalidReason (wrong proxy in upto signature), invalid_eoa_signature (signature not 0x-prefixed or not 65 bytes), upto_signature_route_conflict (both sessionCert and EOA secp256k1 route) -> CLI/SDK bug, not user error; surface the message and stop.

units.title: TEE signing failure / session expired
units.text: TEE signing failure / session expired -> re-login or fall back to pay-local (exact+EIP-3009 / exact+Permit2 / upto, not aggr_deferred); ask the user, don't silently cancel.
units.liteNote: Re-login = social-login link flow ('ocl wallet login' -> loginUrl -> '--phase poll').

units.title: insufficient_allowance = Permit2 allowance insufficient
units.text: Facilitator error code 'insufficient_allowance' -> same as 'Permit2 allowance insufficient': show the one-time Permit2 approve prompt and retry.

units.title: accepts schemes are EVM-only; wallet needs a chain address
units.text: EVM only (CAIP-2 eip155:<chainId>); a non-EVM 'network' -> stop, tell the user the resource is unsupported. No wallet for chain -> the logged-in account needs an address on the target chain; add it via okx-agentic-wallet.

units.title: Signature binding and settlement model
units.text: TEE path: secp256k1 key never leaves the enclave; signature bound to its fields (exact: from, to, value, nonce; upto: also witness.facilitator, so a leaked signature is usable only by the named facilitator); cannot be retargeted or replayed past deadline. sessionCert (aggr_deferred) proves the session key's authority; CLI embeds it. This path only signs — settlement happens on-chain when recipient/facilitator redeems.

units.title: When to load subscription.md
units.text: Load only when a 402 accepts[] entry has scheme == "period", or the user asks to manage an existing subscription (access / change / cancel). Skip on one-shot exact / aggr_deferred / upto offers.

units.title: period scheme model
units.text: Recurring billing: buyer subscribes once — signs a Permit2 PermitSingle (bounded allowance to the subscription contract) + a SubscriptionTerms EIP-712 authorization — then serves the resource with a lightweight 'APP-Access' proof header without re-paying. Buyer self-manages: change (upgrade/downgrade), cancel, cancel-pending (revoke scheduled downgrade), my-subscriptions and allowance-status (inspect).

units.title: Subscription commands sign or read only; no confirming gate
units.text: Every subscription command signs or reads only — none broadcasts a transaction or moves funds (on-chain execution is seller/facilitator-side, bounded by the signed Permit2 permit.amount / permit.expiration). All print the standard {ok, data|error} envelope; exit 0 (success) / 1 (error) only — no 'confirming' gate (the conversational confirm still applies).

units.title: Subscription operation decision table
units.text: New period offer, no active sub for this host -> 'subscribe --accepts '<json>' --url <url>'. Resource already has an active sub (check my-subscriptions first) -> 'access --url <url>' — never re-subscribe. Change-offer 402 (extra.changeFrom), upgrade/downgrade -> access (proof) -> proof-carrying probe -> 'change --accepts '<json>' --sub-id <cur>'. Cancel -> 'cancel --sub-id <s> --contract <c>'. Revoke scheduled downgrade -> 'cancel-pending --sub-id <s> --new-sub-id <n> --contract <c>'. Inspect / reconcile -> 'my-subscriptions' · 'allowance-status --token <t>'.

units.title: Allowance pre-flight bounds
units.text: subscribe/change read allowance-status immediately before signing (fresh nonce / reservedAmount / permit2Allowance; CLI does it). Signed Permit2 must satisfy permit.amount ≥ reservedAmount + this subscription's total commitment; permit.expiration must cover the service window (fixed_seconds: startAt + maxPeriods × periodSec; calendar_month: addMonths(effective_start, maxPeriods)).

units.title: allowance_expired -> one-time ERC20 -> Permit2 approve
units.text: permit2Allowance insufficient (first payment for that token, or grown window) -> command errors with 'allowance_expired' guidance: run the one-time ERC20 -> Permit2 approve via the existing approve flow (NOT a subscription verb), then retry.

units.title: subscribe/change: replay payment header, persist subId
units.text: Replay .data.paymentHeaderValue under header .data.paymentHeaderName (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE); persist .data.subId (CLI also caches host -> subId).

units.title: access: replay APP-Access proof
units.text: Replay .data.accessHeaderValue under header 'APP-Access'. .data.source = 'cache' | 'override' tells whether subId came from the local cache or --sub-id.

units.title: cancel / cancel-pending: relay auth; billing continues until executed
units.text: Relay .data.cancelAuth / .data.pendingChangeCancelAuth to the seller. The sub stays active/billable until the contract executes; the local cache is NOT flipped to canceled (my-subscriptions reconcile corrects it later). cancel-pending --new-sub-id must equal the on-chain pending newSubId (from my-subscriptions pendingPlanChange.newSubId).

units.title: my-subscriptions state codes
units.text: .data.subscriptions[] item 'state': 0 pending / 1 active / 2 completed / 3 canceled / 4 changed / 99 failed. Local cache is reconciled from this authoritative state.

units.title: allowance-status fields
units.text: allowance-status always returns all 10 fields (approvedAmount, reservedAmount, permit2Allowance, subscriptionContract, permit2Contract, …).

units.title: Subscription flag semantics and defaults
units.text: --chain default xlayer / 196 (resolved via chains::resolve_chain); --from default = selected account. subscribe --accepts = the 402 accepts array or single object (must contain a period entry); --url = resource.url and cache-key host. access --url required (host = cache key); --sub-id overrides cache (source=override). change --accepts carries extra.changeFrom; --sub-id required, overrides extra.changeFrom.fromSubId. cancel/cancel-pending --contract = EIP-712 verifying-domain address; --token used to look it up via allowance-status when omitted. my-subscriptions --limit default 50, --offset default 0. allowance-status --token required.

units.title: Change probe must carry APP-Access proof
units.text: The change endpoint only returns a full change-offer with extra.changeFrom (direction + fromSubId) when the probe proves ownership. A naked probe returns an offer missing extra.changeFrom, which fails change signing and forces a wasteful re-probe. Required sequence: 1) 'payment subscription access --url <change endpoint>' (replay .data.accessHeaderValue as APP-Access); 2) probe the change endpoint WITH that APP-Access header -> 402 change-offer with extra.changeFrom; 3) 'payment subscription change --accepts '<that offer>' --sub-id <cur>'. Never naked probe -> re-probe.

units.title: access with no cached sub
units.text: access with no cached sub and no --sub-id -> error names the host; run my-subscriptions to reconcile the cache, or pass --sub-id.

units.title: Contract mismatch is a fail-closed security stop
units.text: 'subscription contract mismatch' / 'permit2 contract mismatch': before signing, subscribe/change cross-check seller extra.contracts.subscription / extra.contracts.permit2 against authoritative allowance-status values; any mismatch or missing authoritative value -> {"ok": false, "error": "… contract mismatch: …"}, exit 1, BEFORE any signature or approve (possible tampered contract). Do NOT retry, re-probe, or force; abort and surface to the user. No --force bypass; never a confirming gate.

units.title: periodSec consistency
units.text: fixed_seconds requires periodSec > 0; calendar_month requires periodSec == 0; inconsistency errors out.

units.title: period is EVM-only
units.text: period is EVM-only (Permit2 / EIP-712 / EIP-191); Solana (501) and other non-EVM chains are out of scope.

units.title: Subscription signing is TEE-only; no key input
units.text: Signatures are always produced by the logged-in wallet's TEE path; no plaintext key/mnemonic in code, logs, or output. The CLI never accepts a private key or a hand-crafted signature.
units.liteNote: Requires a live wallet session: social-login link flow ('ocl wallet login' -> loginUrl -> '--phase poll').

units.title: Contract addresses anchored to the authoritative allowance-status
units.text: Comparison is EVM checksum-insensitive; empty/absent authoritative value fails closed. On match, the AUTHORITATIVE values are used as Permit2 spender, EIP-712 verifyingContracts, and Layer-1 approve target — never an unverified seller declaration. cancel/cancel-pending resolve the contract from allowance-status with --token, or use caller-supplied --contract verbatim (no cross-check) — acceptable because CancelAuth / PendingChangeCancelAuth carry no transfer authority.

units.title: Bounded commitment; never re-subscribe
units.text: Financial exposure is capped by the signed Permit2 permit.amount / permit.expiration; the pre-sign allowance check enforces the bound. Never re-subscribe an already-active resource — access or change it instead.
